analysis_en: Hugo Adeyemi gave Redwick Wanderers the lead with a low-driven finish that beat the keeper at the near post, making it 1-0 and immediately putting his team ahead [F-SCORE-000001], the shot was hit with notable power at 92 km/h, underlining the quality of the strike [F-SHOT_SPEED-000002].

texts.en: Hugo Adeyemi bends a low-driven shot past the keeper at the near post, giving Redwick Wanderers the lead 1-0. The strike came off the boot at 92 km/h.
texts.it: Al minuto 10 Hugo Adeyemi sblocca con un rasoterra che supera il portiere sul primo palo, 1-0; il tiro viaggia a 92,1 km/h.
texts.es: ¡Golazo de Hugo Adeyemi! En el minuto 10 empuja un disparo raso a 92,1 km/h al palo corto y pone el 1-0 para Redwick Wanderers.

analysis_en: Hugo Adeyemi’s powerful low drive was struck at 96 km/h and left the keeper no chance, putting Redwick Wanderers up 2-0 in the 13th minute [F-SCORE-000002] [F-SHOT_SPEED-000003].

texts.en: Adeyemi smashes a powerful low drive into the near post at 96.3 km/h, the keeper left no chance and Redwick Wanderers go 2-0.
texts.it: Botta potente di Hugo Adeyemi, palla bassa sul palo vicino e portiere senza scampo: minuto 13, tiro a 96,3 km/h, Redwick Wanderers ora 2-0.
texts.es: ¡Goooool! Hugo Adeyemi la coloca con un disparo raso a 96,3 km/h y el portero no puede llegar, y ahora es 2-0 para Redwick Wanderers (minuto 13).

texts.es: Ocasión clara para Chidi Lindqvist: disparo a 66,9 km/h, sin gol.

texts.es: ¡Casi marca Tariq Kimura con un disparo raso desde 5,6 m a 82,6 km/h que el portero saca en el primer palo!

analysis_en: This mattered because Kimura followed up immediately with a close-range effort from 7 m at 63 km/h that was saved, keeping Ostwick still trailing 2-0 and missing a chance to start a comeback [F-SHOT_SPEED-000008] [F-SHOT_DISTANCE-000008].

texts.en: Kimura's close follow-up at minute 42, 63.3 km/h from 7.1 m, comfortably saved from inside the box.

texts.es: A renglón seguido, Tariq Kimura prueba de nuevo desde 7,1 m a 63,3 km/h y otra parada evita el gol.

analysis_en: Redwick’s two quick goals early in the game put them 2-0 up at half-time, making their strong passing (83% vs Ostwick 81%) a foundation for control despite Ostwick’s work rate (Tariq Kimura 6.0 km) and Redwick’s top sprint (Chidi Lindqvist 32.8 km/h) [F-SCORE-000001, F-SCORE-000002, F-PASS_ACCURACY-000001, F-PASS_ACCURACY-000013, F-SPRINT_SPEED-000040, F-DISTANCE_COVERED-000022].

texts.en: Two quick strikes from Hugo Adeyemi in minute 10 and minute 13 put Redwick Wanderers 2-0, and their passing at 82.6% has helped them control large spells by half-time.
texts.it: Fine primo tempo: RED 2-0 OST. Precisione nei passaggi 83% e 81%.
texts.es: Rápida estocada de Hugo Adeyemi en el minuto 10 y otra en el minuto 13; Redwick Wanderers mandan 2-0 al descanso y dominan con 82,6% de pases completados frente al 81% de Ostwick FC.

texts.en: Ostwick turned up the press around minute 47, 6.1/10 intensity, forcing Redwick to play hurriedly near their box.
texts.it: La pressione di Ostwick FC al minuto 47 ha forzato ricezioni affrettate in area avversaria, con intensità 6,1/10.
texts.es: La presión de Ostwick FC se dispara en el minuto 47, intensidad 6,1/10, y obliga a apresurar salidas cerca del área rival.

analysis_en: Ostwick’s momentum climbed sharply across successive windows (from 3.8 to 8.6 then 8.0/10), showing a clear surge in control late in the half that suggests they are growing into the game despite trailing 2-0 [F-MOMENTUM-000014, F-MOMENTUM-000016, F-MOMENTUM-000018, F-MOMENTUM-000020].

texts.en: Ostwick’s control climbed through the half, 3.8/10 at minute 35, 4.2/10 at minute 40, then 8.6/10 and 8/10 by minute 45 and 47 respectively, a clear surge.
texts.it: Il momentum di Ostwick è cresciuto progressivamente dai valori 3,8/10 e 4,2/10 fino a 8,6/10 e 8/10, segno di una spinta decisa negli ultimi minuti del tempo.
texts.es: Ostwick FC toma el control: impulso 8/10.

analysis_en: Tariq Kimura pulled one back for Ostwick FC with a low-driven strike after a quick cut, reducing the deficit to make the score 2-1 and giving his side momentum [F-SCORE-000003]. The shot was struck hard at 96 km/h, showing it was a powerful and precise finish under pressure [F-SHOT_SPEED-000010].

texts.en: A neat cut and low-driven strike from Tariq Kimura squeezes inside the keeper’s near post, 2-1, Redwick Wanderers lead.
texts.it: Al 50, Tariq Kimura riduce lo svantaggio con un tiro rasoterra nell’angolo dopo un rapido cambio di passo; palla sotto pressione e infilata a 95,8 km/h, ora 2-1.
texts.es: Tariq Kimura recorta con un disparo raso tras un recorte rápido, el balón entra pegado al palo; fuerte tiro a 95,8 km/h y el marcador queda 2-1 a favor de Redwick Wanderers.

analysis_en: Chidi Lindqvist produced an explosive top speed of 35.6 km/h to run behind the defence and beat the last man, a decisive physical moment that helped Redwick maintain their 2-1 lead [F-SPRINT_SPEED-000090].

texts.en: Chidi Lindqvist flies past the last defender, reaching 35.6 km/h on a decisive run that keeps Redwick Wanderers ahead.
texts.it: Fuga fulminea di Chidi Lindqvist che sfrutta la velocità per superare l’ultima linea, minuto 55; tocco decisivo dopo uno sprint a 35,6 km/h.
texts.es: Desborde explosivo de Chidi Lindqvist que deja atrás a la última línea tras alcanzar 35,6 km/h en el minuto 55.

analysis_en: Tariq Kimura nearly changed the game with a powerful 105 km/h long-range strike from 15 m that rattled the keeper but went narrowly wide, keeping the score Redwick Wanderers 2, Ostwick FC 1 [F-SHOT_SPEED-000014] [F-SHOT_DISTANCE-000014].

texts.en: Tariq Kimura lashes a 105.3 km/h effort from 14.5 m that rattles the keeper but drifts wide.
texts.it: Una bordata da fuori di Tariq Kimura al minuto 73, 105,3 km/h e da 14,5 m: il portiere viene scosso ma la palla sfiora il palo.
texts.es: Disparo potente de Tariq Kimura desde 14,5 m, 105,3 km/h; el portero repelió y la pelota se fue rozando el poste, minuto 73.

analysis_en: Redwick Wanderers clearly shifted their shape around the 70s, moving from a 4-3-3 earlier to a 4-4-2 from minute 70-75 while holding a defensive line about 25.4 m from goal and slightly increasing team width, a tactical change aimed at balancing midfield and attack without altering the 2-1 lead [F-FORMATION-000025] [F-FORMATION-000030] [F-LINE_HEIGHT-000031] [F-TEAM_WIDTH-000031].

texts.en: Redwick Wanderers switch into a 4-4-2 around minute 75, pushing the line to 25.4 m and stretching out to 39.8 m to shore up midfield.
texts.it: Cambio di modulo che serrano i reparti: Redwick passa al 4-4-2 intorno al minuto 75, linea difensiva a 25,4 m e ampiezza che sale a 39,8 m.
texts.es: El técnico reorganiza a Redwick Wanderers a 4-4-2 desde el minuto 70 hasta el 75, con la línea a 25,4 m y la anchura subiendo a 39,8 m para afianzar el medio campo.

analysis_en: Tariq Kimura's 107 km/h driven finish levels the game at 2-2 by beating the keeper at the near post in minute 81, making it the equaliser that keeps Ostwick FC back in the match [F-SHOT_SPEED-000016] [F-SCORE-000004].

texts.en: Kimura lashes a 107 km/h driven finish into the near post to beat the keeper and make it 2-2.
texts.it: Tariq Kimura firma il pareggio con una conclusione potente che batte il portiere sul primo palo; minuto 81, 107 km/h, 2-2.
texts.es: Minuto 81: Tariq Kimura empalma un disparo a 107 km/h que supera al portero en el poste cercano y pone el 2-2.

analysis_en: Ostwick FC complete a comeback to draw 2-2 after having trailed 2-0, with goals conceded at 10 and 13 and strikes from Kimura at 50 and 81 restoring parity [F-SCORE-000001] [F-SCORE-000002] [F-SCORE-000003] [F-SCORE-000004].

texts.en: Trailed 2-0 after minute 13, Ostwick fight back with Kimura strikes at minute 50 and minute 81 to make it 2-2.
texts.it: Rimonta completata: Ostwick pareggia grazie alla rete che ristabilisce la parità al minuto 81, dopo il primo gol di Tariq Kimura al minuto 50 che aveva riaperto la partita; risultato finale 2-2.
texts.es: De estar 2-0 abajo tras los goles en minuto 10 y minuto 13, Ostwick FC se repone: Kimura empata en minuto 81 para dejar el partido 2-2.

analysis_en: Full time analysis matters because after Redwick led 2-0 through two early Hugo Adeyemi goals at minutes 10 and 13, Ostwick fought back with Tariq Kimura strikes at 50 and 81 to secure a 2-2 draw, leaving the match level at full time [F-SCORE-000001] [F-SCORE-000002] [F-SCORE-000003] [F-SCORE-000004]. The draw also reflected balanced team metrics with similar pass accuracy for both sides and high individual workrates, notably Ostwick's Kimura covering 12.0 km and both teams completing around 83% passing, which helps explain the match ebb and flow [F-DISTANCE_COVERED-000052] [F-PASS_ACCURACY-000025] [F-PASS_ACCURACY-000041].

texts.en: Both sides completed roughly 82.5% and 83.9% passing, while Kimura covered 12 km and Chidi Lindqvist hit 35.6 km/h on a sprint.
texts.it: Statistiche equilibrate: passaggi completati intorno a 82,5% e 83,9% e Kimura ha macinato 12 km, mentre Lindqvist ha toccato i 35,6 km/h in uno scatto.
texts.es: Ostwick llegó al empate gracias al desgaste de Kimura, que recorrió 12 km, y ambos equipos rondaron el 82,5% y el 83,9% de acierto en el pase; resultado final 2-2.
